label: Approach the Guild Board
title: Saint Veyra Guild Board
body: Wax-sealed contracts overlap beneath a bronze heading: roadwatch, candle runs, escort requests, and one training-party notice for Little Dawn. The board does not feel like a menu. It feels like the city deciding what kind of person you are.
partyLine: Ysabet Cord glances up long enough to decide you are probably useful.
objective: Pick a social route or contract before leaving Saint Veyra.
sourceNote: Source-safe guild board and contract surface for First Road social play.

label: Watch the Training Yard
title: Oath-Iron Training Yard
body: Shield drills land in a heavy rhythm. No one cheers. The Bulwark lesson is simple enough to be insulting: stand where danger wants to go, then make it regret the route.
partyLine: Halren watches your stance and finds one flaw immediately. Possibly two.
objective: Review Bulwark basics before the road.
sourceNote: Source-safe Saint Veyra Bulwark training identity.

label: Stand in First Bell Plaza
title: First Bell Plaza
body: The public bell is quiet, but the plaza behaves as if it has already heard something. Clerks cross fast. Messengers avoid the center stones. Safe cities have their own kinds of fear.
partyLine: Renn looks at the bell too long, then looks away like he got caught.
objective: Listen to the city before the road.

label: Check the East Road Gate
title: East Road Gate
body: The gate is open in the official sense. The road beyond it looks less open and more patient. A roadwarden charm hangs from the left post, freshly replaced.
partyLine: A roadwatch runner says Hearthmere is quiet, then adds, "quiet enough," which ruins the comfort.
objective: Begin the staged road to Hearthmere.
sourceNote: Source-safe route start for the First Road.

label: Study the Low Walls
title: Low Field Walls
body: The walls are too low to stop a threat and too deliberate to be decoration. They bend the road into sightlines, choke points, and little promises about where people should run.
partyLine: Edrin nods toward the gaps: "Good defensive ground if something tests the road."
sourceNote: Source-safe Hearthmere topography and starter-road pressure.

label: Follow the Field Path
title: Old Pilgrim Road
body: The path east is worn by more than feet. Cart wheels, roadwarden patrols, candle runners, and nervous pilgrims have all taught it the same direction.
suggestedCommands: travel Road Shrine of Little Dawn
partyLine: Renn murmurs the first line of a road prayer and stops before the second.
objective: Follow the field path toward Little Dawn.
sourceNote: Source-safe Hearthmere to Little Dawn route.

label: Read the Road Sign
title: Claw-Marked Signpost
body: The sign still points to Little Dawn. Fresh claw marks cut across the word little, which feels petty enough to be personal.
suggestedCommands: travel Road Shrine of Little Dawn
partyLine: Tallowwick says, "I officially dislike literate claw marks."
objective: Treat the road warning as real.

label: Listen to the Fog
title: Hearthmere Dawn Fog
body: The fog takes sound apart and returns only the useful pieces: a gate latch, a bird that stops singing, a pilgrim breathing too quickly.
partyLine: Renn is trying not to stare east. He is failing politely.
objective: Read the field mood before moving on.
sourceNote: Source-safe Hearthmere mood and road tension.

label: Study the Candle Rail
title: Little Dawn Candle Rail
body: New candles stand among old wax. Someone has been keeping count, and the count has not been kind.
partyLine: Olla notices you looking and does not stop you.
objective: Learn why Little Dawn opens inward.
sourceNote: Source-safe Road Shrine candle and wax motif.

label: Inspect the Shrine Bell
title: Palm-Sized Bronze Bell
body: The bell is small enough to dismiss and old enough to punish that impulse. Its mouth faces the stone, not the air.
partyLine: Edrin quietly says, "That is not how bells usually ask to be heard."
objective: Inspect the inward bell before descent.

label: Look Down the Crypt Stair
title: Cryptlet Stair
body: The stair curves down before it becomes dark, which is somehow worse. It does not hide the descent. It invites you to agree to it.
partyLine: Renn swallows, then nods once. He can go if you can.
objective: Prepare the party for the Cryptlet.

label: Watch Shrinekeeper Olla
title: Shrinekeeper Olla
body: Olla tends the shrine like a person maintaining a boundary, not a building. Her silence has grammar.
partyLine: Tallowwick whispers, "She has absolutely judged all of us already."
objective: Ask Olla before entering the Cryptlet.

label: Read the Road Trial Oath
title: Road Trial Oath
body: The carved oath is not a puzzle. It is a warning about posture: the road remembers who stood between danger and the small flame.
partyLine: Renn reads the words under his breath and stands a little closer.
sourceNote: Runtime Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet room lesson.

label: Read the Threaded Names
title: Threaded Name Tags
body: The tags make the room personal. This is not enemy trash. It is a list of people the road refuses to let become scenery.
objective: Read the room before the pack.
sourceNote: Runtime Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet room lesson.

label: Stabilize the Wax Channel
title: Wax Seal Channel
body: The wax channel is simple enough to miss and important enough to punish that choice. Stabilize it before the bell cast gets loud.
partyLine: Tallowwick points with two fingers: "That thing is either decorative or extremely rude. I vote rude."
objective: Use object counterplay before the caster punishes the party.
sourceNote: Runtime Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet object lesson.

label: Watch the Road-Seal Bell
title: Road-Seal Bell
body: The bell is not there for atmosphere. When the wax channels light, it can answer the next toll if you use it at the right moment.
partyLine: Renn says, "If it lights, I will call it. Please be the wall when I do."
objective: Use the Road-Seal Bell on Road-Seal Pulse.
